async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the orders table (fourth table in the tree)
    orders_table = page.get_by_role('table').nth(3)
    # Get the filter row (second row in the rowgroup)
    filter_row = orders_table.get_by_role('rowgroup').get_by_role('row').nth(1)
    # The status combobox is in the cell with options including 'Pending'; based on tree, it's the combobox in this row
    status_combobox = filter_row.get_by_role('combobox')
    # Select 'Pending' option
    await status_combobox.select_option('Pending')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Additional sleep to ensure UI updates
    # Get the first data row after filtering (third row in rowgroup, index 2)
    first_order_row = orders_table.get_by_role('rowgroup').get_by_role('row').nth(2)
    # The order ID is in the second cell (index 1) of this row
    order_id_cell = first_order_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(1)
    order_id = await order_id_cell.text_content()
    # Return the order ID
    return order_id.strip()
